description: This file defines the GoogleUser class within the OAuth2 client provider namespace, representing a user resource obtained from Google's OAuth2 service. It provides methods to access user profile information such as ID, name, email, and avatar.

classes.name: GoogleUser
classes.description: Represents a Google user information response, providing accessors for user profile attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleUser instance with a response array containing user data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the user's unique identifier ('sub') from Google's OAuth response.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the user's first name, or null if not available.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the user's last name, or null if not available.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the user's locale, or null if not available.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the user's email address, or null if not available.

methods.name: getHostedDomain
methods.description: Returns the hosted domain of the user, or null if not available.

methods.name: getAvatar
methods.description: Returns the avatar image URL, or null if not available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the entire user response data as an array.
